info.name: Timetable Solver API
info.description: Full-school CP-SAT timetable generation API. Run order: Health Check -> Load Data -> Generate Timetable -> the four GET reports. Select the 'TimetableSolver - Local' environment before running, or edit baseUrl to point at another host. Runnable end-to-end via Postman Runner or Newman.

request.description: Liveness check. No dataset is loaded by this call.

Loads and normalizes the configured dataset (Sample or FullDataset, per appsettings.json) into memory. Returns a summary plus any data conflicts found (UNASSIGNED-TT rows, zero-workload rows, missing curriculum, etc.). Call this before Generate, or let Generate auto-load for you.

exec: pm.test('Response has a solver status', function () {

request.description: Builds the CP-SAT model from the loaded (or auto-loaded) dataset and solves it. On success returns every scheduled lesson grouped by section and by teacher. On failure returns the solver status plus a structured explanation (schedulingConflicts / dataConflicts) of why no schedule exists.

exec: pm.test('404 only if nothing generated yet', function () {

request.description: Returns every section's weekly timetable from the most recent successful generation. 404 if Generate has not produced a schedule yet.

Returns one section's timetable by its raw id (not display name), e.g. 'class-1-lily'. Set the sectionId environment variable to a real id from Data/school-sample.json or Data/sections.json. 404 if the id is unknown or nothing has been generated yet.

Returns every teacher's combined weekly timetable (across all sections they teach) from the most recent successful generation. 404 if nothing has been generated at all yet. Note: if the last Generate call resolved to INFEASIBLE, this currently returns 204 No Content (ASP.NET Core auto-converts the null TeacherTimetables payload) rather than the empty-object 200 that /sections returns for the same situation -- a minor existing API inconsistency, not a Postman issue.

request.description: Returns data-quality conflicts (bad/missing input rows) and scheduling conflicts (why the solver could not find a full schedule, if applicable) from the current in-memory state. Safe to call any time, even before Load Data.
